sampleResults.title: Annual Science Fair 2024
sampleResults.snippet: Students from JSS and SSS present research projects covering biology, chemistry, physics, and technology. The science fair is open to all parents and visitors.

sampleResults.title: Basic Science & Technology
sampleResults.snippet: An integrated introduction to physics, chemistry, biology, and technology through hands-on experiments. Topics include living systems, matter and change, forces and energy.

sampleResults.title: Biology
sampleResults.snippet: Cell biology, genetics, ecology, human anatomy and physiology, plant biology, and evolution. Weekly laboratory sessions develop practical skills in dissection and microscopy.

sampleResults.title: School Wins State Science Olympiad
sampleResults.snippet: Our SSS 2 students claimed first place at the State Science Olympiad held in Abuja, excelling in the biology, chemistry, and physics categories.

sampleResults.title: New Science Laboratory Equipment Installed
sampleResults.snippet: The school has completed installation of upgraded laboratory equipment in the chemistry and biology labs, including new microscopes, titration sets, and safety stations.
